title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Rating prompt with editor-aware review links
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.23.0 adds an optional rating prompt with editor-aware review links, plus a leaner package and a more reliable release pipeline.

highlights.title: Rating Prompt
highlights.description: Added a one-time-per-milestone prompt that appears once Kotlin Jump has proven useful over sustained use, asking for a rating without interrupting your workflow.

highlights.title: Store-Aware Review Links
highlights.description: The rating prompt and the What's New panel now detect your editor and link to the correct review page, the VS Code Marketplace or Open VSX for Cursor, Windsurf, VSCodium, and other forks.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Added a rating prompt that appears after Kotlin Jump has been active for at least 10 sessions over a week, caps at three lifetime prompts, and honors "Don't ask again" permanently.
Routed the rating prompt and the What's New panel's review link to the correct store for your editor: the VS Code Marketplace, or Open VSX for Cursor, Windsurf, VSCodium, and other forks.

sections.heading: Packaging and Docs
bullets: Excluded stray development tool artifacts, such as debug logs and session data, from the packaged extension, keeping installs clean.
Hardened the automated web test suite by forcing headless Chromium, cutting spurious failures during release checks.
